source_note: The DRC production measurement code is unchanged from the base revision; types.rs only adds mod tests. Hypercurve additionally contains the new native-metric module, which these DRC measurements do not call. Retained tests.rs is the complete four-test failing source.
failures: Invalid source construction publishes its placeholder empty region area.
An already exhausted budget scope can obtain and retain successful polygon area and bounds values.
A degree-five rational cap with unavailable authoritative area publishes a rational area computed from its three finite report samples.
limitations: These probes do not demonstrate a previously cached None poisoning a later admitted query. That risk remains a source-audit finding.
The report triangle is a deliberate coarse display projection at exact source parameters 0, 1/2 and 1; the full degree-five native fixture is retained.
